# Secret-scan gate allowlist (known false positives).
# Each non-comment line is an ERE matched against `grep -n` output lines of the
# form `./path:linenumber:content`. Anchor patterns to paths + content so real
# secrets elsewhere in the same files still trip the gate.
#
# redhat-cop upstream test fixtures: PEM headers whose bodies are truncated
# placeholders ("...") on the same line — real key material never contains dots.
^\./api/v1alpha1/[a-z0-9_]+_test\.go:[0-9]+:.*-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH |PGP |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----.*\.\.\.
# redhat-cop upstream test fixtures: stub OPENSSH key with literal body "\nabc\n".
^\./api/v1alpha1/[a-z0-9_]+_test\.go:[0-9]+:.*-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH |PGP |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----\\nabc\\n
# redhat-cop upstream docs example: indented placeholder PEM header in a code
# block (docs/auth-engines/ldap.md).
^\./docs/auth-engines/ldap\.md:[0-9]+:[[:space:]]+-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----[[:space:]]*$
